changeSet.author: nico
changeSet.comment:
RSDEV-1326: index DigitalObjectIdentifier on (type, identifier). The PIDINST lookup asks "is this PID already linked here?" for a whole page of provider hits at once, and the table carried an index only on publicLink, so every one of those was a full scan of a table that grows with every IGSN ever allocated, bulk allocations included.
Written as raw SQL rather than createIndex because the identifier column needs a prefix length and Liquibase cannot express one. 190 characters of utf8mb4 is 760 bytes, which with the 4-byte int keeps the key under the 767-byte limit of the older InnoDB row formats a long-lived deployment may still be using; the full 255 would be 1024 and would fail there. DOIs and Handles are far shorter than 190, so discrimination is unaffected.
Equality column first: type is always an equality match and identifier is matched by IN over the page. deleted is left out deliberately - it is a bit column with two values, so it earns nothing in the key and is cheap to filter afterwards.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE DigitalObjectIdentifier ADD INDEX idx_DigitalObjectIdentifier_type_identifier (type, identifier(190));
